_note: Travel time provider configuration for TransportCorrelationEngine. All route timings here — no hardcoded values in code.

_operatingModes._note: Three operating modes, all using Google for ranges:

DEMO_CLEAR_RAIL.description: Demo — synthetic duration 76 min injected. Google called live. 76 min falls inside Google rail range (74-81), outside road (26-36). Outcome: RAIL, AUTO_PROCESS.

DEMO_CLEAR_ROAD.description: Demo — synthetic duration 30 min injected. Google called live. 30 min falls inside Google road range (26-36), outside rail (74-81). Outcome: CAR, AUTO_PROCESS.

DEMO_AMBIGUOUS_MOCK.description: Demo — true ambiguity scenario. Google ranges for this route are too far apart to overlap. Use MOCK provider where rail (20-30) and road (25-55) genuinely overlap.

LIVE_PRODUCTION.description: Fully live — real elapsed simulator duration vs real Google ranges. Outcome genuinely determined by data.

_currentMode: DEMO_CONTROLLED with live Google ranges — demoScenario injects a synthetic duration calibrated against real Google values. Set demoScenario=null for fully live mode.
_noteDemoScenario: null = fully live (real elapsed duration vs real Google ranges). CLEAR_RAIL | CLEAR_ROAD | AMBIGUOUS = synthetic duration injected, but Google is still called for ranges. demoScenarioTimings MUST be calibrated against real Google values for the active route.
_noteTolerance: Buffer added to each range boundary before comparison. Prevents false mismatches from minor timing noise.
_noteAmbiguityThreshold: Gap 3.2: Overlap >= this value = true ambiguity (triggers validation). Overlap < this = resolvable by tiebreak (MEDIUM confidence, no validation).
_noteDataSourcePriority: Gap 3.7: First available provider in this list is used. Remove or reorder to change priority.

mockData._note: Resolution order: exact station pair key → zone pair fallback → null (no data). Key format: {fromStationId}_{toStationId}
mockData._noteDemoScenarioTimings: Synthetic durations calibrated against REAL Google Directions API values for STN_CENTRAL_STN_AIRPORT. Google observed values vary by time of day: rail ~68-74 min, road ~26-30 min, bus ~76-97 min. CLEAR_RAIL=71 sits safely inside the rail range centre (away from bus boundary at 76). CLEAR_ROAD=30 sits inside road 26-36 and far outside rail 68+. AMBIGUOUS requires MOCK provider (dataSourcePriority=[MOCK]) because real Google rail/road ranges on this route are 38+ min apart and cannot genuinely overlap.

providers._note: Phase 4 stubs — set enabled=true and supply credentials when ready. Falls back to MOCK if provider unavailable.

google._noteApiKey: API key is configured server-side in .env as GOOGLE_DIRECTIONS_API_KEY. The server proxy at /api/transport/directions handles all Google calls.
google._notePessimistic: road pessimistic = best estimate x this multiplier. 1.4 = 40% worse than traffic estimate.

tfl._note: Only applicable for London-area routes. Auto-disabled outside bounding box.
